sourceReview: Every branch and helper reachable within the boundary was traced against nethack-c/upstream/src/: wizcmds.c wiz_wish() whole, zap.c makewish() 6313-6345 statement by statement, cmd.c can_do_extcmd() and rhack()'s dispatch, and the extcmdlist row's flags. The trace covered state and random-number order, and found no random-number call inside the boundary. Stubs, stops and partial implementations were identified: the two dispatch seams that refuse today, the absent js/zap.js, and the four arms of makewish()'s head that cannot occur or belong to a later slice, each with the source condition that settles it. Two limits are recorded in candidateListMethod: readobjnam_postparse1() was not read in full, and the five makewish() call sites outside wizcmds.c were not re-checked.
